name: Shattering Swedge
description: Draw the knife and cut in the opening bow of the contest of two edges.

name: Peelwrath
description: Thrust the point along the line the opposing edge has just left open.

name: Plunge Spine
description: Fold the blade in across the body in a close formal guard against a cut.

name: Torrential Peel
description: Step in two even beats that match the opponent's and then break the pattern.

name: Might Tangpin
description: Slice at the rival blade's wrist as it comes forward and cut the grip.

name: Hoarfrost Buttcap
description: Trap the opposing hand against the body of the blade and hold it in place.

name: Murkscales
description: Parry from a settled seat with both feet planted and let the strike slide wide.

name: Blaze Thumbramp
description: Rake a qi-sharpened edge across the opponent's guard in two quick parallel strokes.

name: Thornswedge
description: Hold a formal shield of field qi around the blade through a long exchange of strikes.

name: Gnashing Slit
description: Bring both the edge and the field edge down at once so that a single cut decides the contest.

name: Choilscourge
description: Skim low across the target like a hawk above a river and cut in passing.

name: Devastating Edgebelly
description: Dart the point forward like a strike at a fish in shallows and withdraw at once.

name: Chime Lanyard
description: Stand like a rock in a river and let blows flow around the blade.

name: Dazzling Choil
description: Glide forward on wide quiet steps with the shoulders level and the blade low.

name: Radiant Bolster
description: Glance at the shadow that falls across the ground to read where the opponent will go.

name: Gust Scales
description: Pass the edge across the guard in one swift slice and leave before the answer.

name: Scales Hardihood
description: Meet a strike and spring the blade back along the flow into a counter cut.

name: Gyve Whittle
description: Hook the opponent's weapon with the heel of the blade and hold it fast.

name: Plungewrath
description: Run down the line of the opponent in a flurry of fast thrusts like rapids.

name: Booming Shave
description: Leap over the guard from above like a hawk crossing water and strike down.

name: Swedge Fortitude
description: Swell a guard of qi around the edge like a river in flood against all strikes.

name: Brutal Trim
description: Stoop in a single dive and drive the field-wrapped point through the guard to its target.

name: Mightplunge
description: Cut along the upper line of the opponent's guard like running along a basin's rim.

name: Forged Buttcap
description: Jab the point in a curved line that follows the hollow of the opponent's guard.

name: Iron Thumbramp
description: Hold the blade low and curved to collect a strike and spill it aside.

name: Grievous Slit
description: Sweep the edge along the ground line to cut ankles and shins in one pass.

name: Murk Tangpin
description: Stir the ground with a low cut so the opponent loses sight of the true line.

name: Mightswedge
description: Circle the opponent at a fixed radius as if walking the rim of a basin.

name: Decimating Plunge
description: Gouge the point into a gap in armor and scoop with a qi-loaded wrist turn.

name: Slithavoc
description: Drop from a high guard to the lowest line in one dropping cut.

name: Rumble Lanyard
description: Pour the field out along the edge in a single overflowing cut that exceeds the blade's reach.

name: Gust Whittle
description: Slice with the economy of long habit and no wasted motion of the arm.

name: Scaleswrath
description: Drive the point in a short straight line as a veteran does without a flourish.

name: Chime Edgebelly
description: Turn the blade over the forearm to cover and cut away in one short motion.

name: Mightslit
description: Walk in the plain rhythm of long practice that the opponent finds hard to read.

name: Galvanizing Buttcap
description: Hold a steady gaze that reads the opponent's two tracks of qi and body together.

name: Torrent Bolster
description: Rush in with qi in the legs while the body track carries the cut.

name: Maiming Trim
description: Tap the opponent's wrist to break the qi track in the middle of a stroke.

name: Ponderous Shave
description: Cross over the opponent's blade and bind it down against the crossguard.

name: Rumblescales
description: Hammer the edge down with qi and body weight landing in the same instant.

name: Honed Swedge
description: Rise from a crouch and pierce upward along the qi track to the throat line.

name: Booming Iron Peel
description: Run qi and body along two rails to one edge for a single decisive cut.

name: Devastating Tangpin
description: Cut with one knife while the second guards the line of the first stroke.

name: Mangling Lanyard
description: Draw the second knife out in the wake of the first cut and cross the stroke.

name: Peelhavoc
description: Thrust with the leading knife while the rear knife readies a cover.

name: Charter Plunge
description: Cross the two blades in front of the body and take the strike on the join.

name: Gust Thumbramp
description: Step in a fixed sequence that matches the alternating strokes of the paired knives.

name: Plungescourge
description: Chain crossing cuts from both knives so each stroke opens the line of the next.

name: Gnashing Choil
description: Reverse the rear knife and hook it into the arm that the front knife has opened.

name: Overpowering Shave
description: Press down on the opponent's weapon with both flats and pin it against the body.

name: Unconquered Choil
description: Parry with one knife and spring the other into a counter cut from the rebound.

name: Tempered Whittle
description: Spin the body between two cutting passes so both blades strike in a turning wheel.

name: Tempered Slit
description: Gather qi in both blades and dive in with both points aimed at one gap.

name: Iron Edgebelly
description: Spread both blades like wings behind a field of qi to guard against many strikes.

name: Ruinous Bolster
description: Close both blades on one point of the opponent with the weight of the whole book behind them.

name: Rumblepare
description: Slip the edge between branching lines of the opponent's guard like a delta.

name: Nova Pare
description: Jab low and slow like silt settling at a river's mouth to catch the leg.

name: Unconquered Scales
description: Turn the blade as water turns at an estuary and send the blow away.

name: Silt Thumbramp
description: Step in and out across a fixed line like the tide along a shore.

name: Devastating Peel
description: Draw the edge back like an ebbing tide and slash as the opponent follows.

name: Sanguine Pare
description: Surge forward in a flood of steps and cuts that overruns the opponent's guard.

name: Pare Valor
description: Mix slow and fast cuts so that the opponent cannot tell fresh water from salt.

name: Titanic Trim
description: Cut in a heavy torrent of qi that drives the opponent back across open ground.

name: Mastering Edgebelly
description: Press the opponent's weapon down like a sandbar catching a keel and hold it there.

name: Tempered Lanyard
description: Gather qi from two directions into the edge and release both in one cut.

name: Gust Shave
description: Cut in the rhythm of a single wing beat with the shoulders open wide.

name: Whittle Devastation
description: Stab the point in with a talon-like curl of the fingers on the handle.

name: Indomitable Scales
description: Throw the free arm wide behind the blade as a wing covering the side.

name: Slit Blink
description: Hop on the balls of the feet as if lifted by an updraft and land ready.

name: Verity Tangpin
description: Read the warmth and breath of the nearby bodies to find who stands behind.

name: Parehavoc
description: Slash wide in the span of a wing and cut anything that crosses the arc.

name: Fastening Plunge
description: Seize the opponent's wrist with the free hand and pin the blade with the knife.

name: Torrent Buttcap
description: Parry the counterblow as the user pulls out of a dive and regains height.

name: Rumble Bolster
description: Hang in place on steady feet and poke at the opponent's face to keep them back.

name: Ponderous Trim
description: Sweep a wide arc of field-backed cuts to drive all attackers back a pace.

name: Tempered Peel
description: Come down from a leap with the talon grip and strike the shoulder line.

name: Scales Vortex
description: Flash across the whole field in a single stoop and land the cut at the end of it.

name: Corroding Choil
description: Cut in the unhurried pace of a master who knows exactly how much reserve remains.

name: Rumblepeel
description: Place the point at the close edge of the opponent's guard and press home.

name: Scalesdurance
description: Turn the blade into the blow by reading the weight of the incoming arm.

name: Mastering Buttcap
description: Check the opponent's weapon hand with the free palm and press the blade over it.

name: Shavehavoc
description: Slice with only as much qi as the reserve can spare and no more.

name: Gust Peel
description: Step in calm measured paces that save breath and qi on a long duel.

name: Blaze Lanyard
description: Cut with exactly the qi the user's tally allows and no more than the foe's guard needs.

name: Unassailable Swedge
description: Hold a calm steady guard that conserves qi and gives ground slowly.

name: Brutalizing Rumble Whittle
description: Drive a qi-sealed point through the guard with the full weight of a Monarch's reserve.

name: Pitiless Slit
description: Cut from a rooted stance as if the wind itself stood behind the blade.

name: Nova Plunge
description: Thrust with both feet rooted so the wind's force runs through the point.

name: Swedgemettle
description: Stand firm and turn the strike aside with a flick of the blade like a gust.

name: Granite Trim
description: Walk on a fixed bearing toward the opponent and refuse to turn from it.

name: Waning Choil
description: Look into the wind to read what the air carries from the opponent's side.

name: Tangpin Devastation
description: Slice from a rooted stance on an oath to give no ground.

name: Impervious Bolster
description: Parry with a sharp twist that turns the strike like a gust turns a leaf.

name: Fastening Shave
description: Hold the opponent's weapon pressed down as steadily as a wind holds a banner.

name: Blaze Swedge
description: Cut with a gale of qi stored in the rooted legs and released through the arm.

name: Granite Thumbramp
description: Hold a rooted guard in which a storm of qi circles the user and the blade.

name: Corroding Buttcap
description: Release the whole standing wind through the edge in one cut sworn never to retreat.

name: Gust Swedge
description: Cut level and flat across the opponent's mid-line like a plateau's edge.

name: Facet Choil
description: Jab along the set bearing so the point reaches the same place each time.

name: Hoarfrost Edgebelly
description: Hold the blade along the ridge line of the forearm as a straight steady guard.

name: Tempered Plunge
description: Slice down a steep line as along an escarpment from the high guard.

name: Torrential Whittle
description: Turn smoothly to a new bearing in one step without losing the line.

name: Thorntrim
description: Bind the opponent's weapon at the edge of their reach and hold it there.

name: Unsparing Pare
description: Strike with qi carried in the wind that sweeps across the plateau.

name: Chimeplunge
description: Parry like a stone at the plateau's rim that the wind cannot move.

name: Gustchoil
description: Take a bearing and send field and edge along it in one unbroken cut.

name: Tempered Pare
description: Open with a first cut taken on the sworn wind that pushes from behind.

name: Rumble Shave
description: Jab the point forward on the wind's push and withdraw before the counter.

name: Impenetrable Lanyard
description: Cover the body with the flat of the blade as the wind presses against it.

name: Pare Glare
description: Glide on the wind's push along a bearing without raising the feet.

name: Beneficent Bolster
description: Listen to the wind for the sound of a foe's blade or breath.

name: Sanguine Trim
description: Chop down with the wind behind the edge and the oath behind the wrist.

name: Tempered Scales
description: Return a strike with a cut that rides the same gust that carried the first.

name: Overbearing Slit
description: Pin the opponent's blade against the ground as the wind presses it down.

name: Meteoric Swedge
description: Dash forward on the push of the wind and cut as the feet land.

name: Rampaging Edgebelly
description: Draw a gust-sharpened edge through the guard and rend the weapon arm.

name: Tangpin Spine
description: Hold a circling guard in which the sworn wind turns away every strike.

name: Gnashing Granite Choil
description: Gather the sworn winds into one last gust and loose them through the edge.

name: Ironslit
description: Cut from the saddle in a sideways stroke at a passing foot soldier.

name: Facetpeel
description: Jab the point at the reins or bridle of an opposing rider to unseat them.

name: Scalesvalor
description: Turn the blade over the rider's thigh to deflect a blow from below.

name: Lightning Scales
description: Swing off the mount and land on both feet with the knife already ready.

name: Rumbleswedge
description: Hook the edge around a spear haft and slice the hand that holds it.

name: Tempered Thumbramp
description: Cut the stirrup strap of a rival rider as the two horses pass.

name: Murk Pare
description: Kick up a screen of dust and cut through it from an unexpected side.

name: Trimruin
description: Cut overhand with the speed of the ride and a gust of qi on the edge.

name: Unbowed Buttcap
description: Parry a lance or spear along the line of the ride and turn it past the saddle.

name: Blinding Hour Tangpin
description: Flash past the opponent in the speed of a charge and cut as the field passes through.

name: Iron Plunge
description: Cut along the first sworn bearing of the canon with the edge steady.

name: Glintchoil
description: Thrust on the second sworn bearing that turns a quarter from the first.

name: Choilspine
description: Guard on the third bearing and turn the strike off the user's line.

name: Torrent Edgebelly
description: Step on the fourth bearing to flank the opponent without crossing the feet.

name: Tempered Bolster
description: Hold the fifth bearing while reading the wind and the opponent's stance.

name: Ironscales
description: Cross two sworn bearings with the edge in a single X-shaped cut.

name: Peel Reckoning
description: Hold the bearing against the opponent's attack and answer along the same line.

name: Shade Slit
description: Lock the opponent's blade along the bearing and press it flat to the ground.

name: Mightpare
description: Rush along a sworn bearing and cut at the end of it without turning aside.

name: Booming Trim
description: Split the opponent's guard along a sworn bearing with a gale of qi.

name: Nova Whittle
description: Gather qi on a sworn bearing and drive the point through the guard in one thrust.

name: Iron Lanyard
description: Turn on the sworn bearing behind a shield of qi so each blow slides aside.

name: Mangling Peel
description: Bring all five sworn bearings to one cut and release the whole field through the edge.

name: Granite Swedge
description: Cut with an oath sworn to hold the open ground and step back from none.

name: Facet Trim
description: Jab the point as the oath is spoken and follow the arm with the whole body.

name: Aegischoil
description: Cover the chest with the blade in a guard sworn never to drop.

name: Phantom Shave
description: Run in a straight line across open ground with the knife held low.

name: Tangpin Vitality
description: Look to the horizon to judge where the opponent's friends might approach.

name: Sanguine Thumbramp
description: Slice beneath the open sky in a long arc that no wall limits.

name: Tempered Edgebelly
description: Hold the guard high and counter from above as the opponent commits.

name: Parenerve
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with the blade and the heel and drag it aside.

name: Granite Slit
description: Sweep a wide sworn arc of cuts that keeps several attackers out of range.

name: Unbowed Scales
description: Take a blow on the planted foot and send its force back through the blade.

name: Scaleshavoc
description: Pour the whole of a sworn vow into the edge and strike once without any retreat.

name: Ruinous Lanyard
description: Cut across the wind's line in the first drilled stroke of the lesson.

name: Facetplunge
description: Stab a pinpoint through the wind's push toward a gap in the guard.

name: Equipoise Buttcap
description: Slip the blade across the wind and the strike so that both pass the body.

name: Shave Blink
description: Run into a hard wind with short low steps that keep the balance.

name: Pareruin
description: Rake the edge along a gale's line in two quick strokes down the guard.

name: Blaze Choil
description: Meet an advance with a swelling counter that grows as the wind gains.

name: Waningplunge
description: Keep still in the gale's eye and read every movement within the field.

name: Parescourge
description: Surge qi into the edge and cut through a hard gale and the guard behind it.

name: Plungevalor
description: Hold a still point at the center of the storm where no blow can land.

name: Sanguine Whittle
description: Cut so cleanly through the wind that it falls still around the blade for a breath.

name: Might Peel
description: Cut at the pace the wind allows and hold the blade true through it.

name: Facetswedge
description: Jab with the blade held steady against a crosswind that would push it off.

name: Facet Thumbramp
description: Cover the line of attack with the flat held firm against the wind.

name: Ghosting Plunge
description: Step along a held line that the wind cannot push the user off.

name: Plungerespite
description: Hold the breath still and read the wind and the opponent through the blade.

name: Tangpin Ruin
description: Slice with the wind and a Monarch's patient control of the reserve.

name: Granite Bolster
description: Answer a gust of attack with a counter that waits for the lull.

name: Choilvalor
description: Bind the opponent's weapon and hold it down until the wind shifts.

name: Gusttrim
description: Rush forward as a gust drops and cut before the next one rises.

name: Blistering Whittle
description: Cut with the full steady qi of a Monarch against a rising gale.

name: Choilmettle
description: Parry with the wind itself as the blade holds a straight steady line.

name: Eviscerating Slit
description: Hold the blade true against every gust and bring the whole wind down in one cut.
